title: Public Pier Pilot to Activate Marina Quay West Ahead of Permanent Park
summary: Opening September 18, 2026, Public Pier will bring a temporary cultural destination to Marina Quay West at 539 Queens Quay West. Running over three weekends, the pilot will test possible uses for the site before its transformation into a permanent City park and cultural venue. Beside the Toronto Music Garden and across the Portland Street slip from the Canada Malting Silos, the sizeable pier occupies a prominent location on the western waterfront. Beside its expansive city and harbour views, it currently offers visitors few reasons to drop by.
